# Yuval Karako

Yuval Karako is an M.Sc. researcher in Biotechnology at Bar-Ilan University, working at the intersection of artificial intelligence and marine ecology. He develops AI workflows that connect visual observation with scientific evidence to support the interpretation of ecological change. He also leads R&D and product work in the public-security sector and teaches in HIGH AI, focusing on agentic workflows, Second Brains, and personal knowledge bases.

## Profile

- [Professional profile](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/profile): biography, current work and contact.
- [Markdown profile](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/profile.md)

## Work

- [Ecological intelligence](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/ecological-intelligence/text): Developing AI workflows that connect computer vision, ecological measurement, and scientific literature — to help interpret change in marine ecosystems.
- [Institutional R&D](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/institutional-systems/text): Leading R&D and product work in the public-security sector. Connecting the problem, the architecture, and the people needed to turn an idea into an operational system.
- [Teaching agentic AI](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/high-ai/text): Teaching researchers and senior academics to build personal knowledge bases and put agentic AI to work — connecting deep domain expertise with new ways of thinking and building.
- [AI for marine monitoring](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/marine-ai-review/text): Examining how AI is used in marine ecological monitoring, and the gap between visual detection and ecological interpretation.
- [Human–AI knowledge systems](https://yuvalkarako.github.io/work/knowledge-infrastructure/text): Developing ways to turn notes, sources, and experience into a connected knowledge base that people and AI agents can work with together.
